mapper.select: SELECT p.id::text AS publication_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM publication_reactions r WHERE r.publication_id=p.id AND r.kind='LIKE') AS like_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_reactions r WHERE r.publication_id=p.id AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.kind='LIKE') AS liked, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_reactions r WHERE r.publication_id=p.id AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.kind='BOOKMARK') AS bookmarked FROM publications p WHERE p.is_deleted=false AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.delivery_status='AVAILABLE' AND p.id IN #{id}
